description.zh: 整理照片和手机视频：按拍摄时间（EXIF、文件名、修改时间）归档到“年/年-月”，可按拍摄时间重命名，截图和微信图片单独归档，实况照片视频和编辑记录跟随，找出重复备份的照片。先出方案、确认后执行、可一键撤销，不删除也不修改任何照片。
description.en: Organizes photos and phone videos by date taken (EXIF, file name, or modified time) into Year/Year-Month folders, optionally renames by timestamp, separates screenshots and WeChat images, keeps Live Photo pairs together, and finds duplicate backups. Plan first, undo anytime — never deletes or edits photos.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我照片放在哪个文件夹，我先帮你看看分布情况
welcome_message.en: Tell me where your photos are — I'll start with an overview

prompt.zh: 帮我看看 ___ 里有多少照片，分布在哪些年份，有什么问题。
prompt.en: How many photos are in ___, which years do they span, and what issues are there?

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里的照片按拍摄时间整理到 ___，按“年/年-月”分文件夹，先给我看方案。
prompt.en: Archive photos in ___ into ___ by date taken (Year/Year-Month). Show the plan first.

prompt.zh: 整理手机备份目录 ___：按拍摄时间重命名，截图和微信图片单独放。
prompt.en: Organize the phone backup in ___: rename by date taken and separate screenshots and WeChat images.

prompt.zh: 找出 ___ 里重复备份的照片，先移到一边让我确认。
prompt.en: Find photos backed up more than once in ___ and set them aside for review.

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里的截图和微信图片挑出来单独归档，按年份分好。
prompt.en: Pull screenshots and WeChat images out of ___ and archive them by year.

prompt.zh: 刚才的照片整理不满意，帮我撤销。
prompt.en: I don't like the last photo reorganization. Undo it.

zh: 每周日「22:00」检查手机备份目录的新照片，生成归档方案发给我确认
每月 1 日「10:00」体检照片库，报告新增数量和只能按修改时间归档的照片
每月最后一天「21:00」把本月截图单独归档，列出数量
每季度第一天「10:00」查找重复备份的照片，生成待确认清单
每年 1 月 1 日「10:00」统计去年各月的照片数量
每月 15 日「20:00」提醒我确认 _重复文件待确认 目录里的照片
en: Every Sunday at 22:00, check new phone backup photos and send me an archiving plan
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, health-check the photo library: new photos and those dated by modified time
On the last day of each month at 21:00, archive this month's screenshots and report the count
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, find duplicate backups for review
On January 1 each year at 10:00, count last year's photos by month
On the 15th of each month at 20:00, remind me to review photos in the duplicates folder
